caseStudies.title: DTC launch with compliant age gating
caseStudies.text: Age verification, restricted-region logic and carrier rules enforced at checkout rather than bolted on afterwards — so compliance stopped being a manual review step.

caseStudies.title: Replatform without losing rankings
caseStudies.text: Catalogue, customer accounts and a decade of order history migrated, with organic search equity held through cutover and trading uninterrupted.

caseStudies.title: Order operations, automated
caseStudies.text: ERP and 3PL integration that removed manual re-keying from every order — the team stopped growing headcount to keep pace with volume.
